name: markaz-asnad-library-research-pwa
description: Local-first PWA for library inventory and research at Markaz Asnad

scripts.build: npm run expand:sources && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/compress-runtime.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && node scripts/smoke.mjs && node scripts/browser-smoke.mjs && npm run assemble:site && node scripts/static-smoke.mjs
scripts.build:site: npm run build && npm run assemble:site
